---
title: "RNA-seq-QC"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# load in multiqc data
QC_raw_full <- read.delim("../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt", header = TRUE)
QC_raw <- read.delim("../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_general_stats.txt", header = TRUE)

colnames(QC_raw) <- str_replace(colnames(QC_raw) , "FastQC_mqc.generalstats.fastqc.", "") 
```

```{r}
QC_raw <- QC_raw %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(Sample, "run-2-", "")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(sample_id, "_S[0-9]+", ""))

QC_raw_summarized <- QC_raw %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seq = sum(total_sequences),
    n_fastqs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_Mseq = total_seq/1000000)

QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15) 
paste(nrow(QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15))/2, "samples have fewer than 15M reads in each direction")

write.csv(QC_raw_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq), "../output_RNA/raw_qc/multiqc_data/concatenated_runs_nreads.csv")
```


```{r}
# load in multiqc data
QC_trim <- read.delim("../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_fastqc.txt", header = TRUE)
#QC_trim <- read.delim("../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/multiqc_general_stats.txt", header = TRUE)
```

```{r}
QC_trim <- QC_trim %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(Sample, "run-2-", "")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_replace(sample_id, "_S[0-9]+", ""))

QC_trim_summarized <- QC_trim %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_seq = sum(Total.Sequences),
    n_fastqs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(total_Mseq = total_seq/1000000)

QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15) 
paste(nrow(QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) %>% filter(total_Mseq < 15))/2, "samples have fewer than 15M reads in each direction")

write.csv(QC_trim_summarized %>% arrange(total_Mseq) , "../output_RNA/trimmed_qc/multiqc_data/concatenated_runs_nreads_post_trim.csv")
```

### rRNA contamination and mapping comparison


```{r}
# load in multiqc data of mapping data
POR_map <- read.delim("../output_RNA/alignment_qc/POR_Pcomp/multiqc_data/multiqc_star.txt", header = TRUE)
POR_rRNA <- read.csv("../output_RNA/rRNA_screen/rRNA_contamination_bbduk_POR.csv") %>% select(-total_reads)
```

```{r}
POR_rRNA <- POR_rRNA %>% left_join(POR_map %>% select(Sample,total_reads, uniquely_mapped, uniquely_mapped_percent), by = join_by(sample==Sample))

POR_rRNA <- POR_rRNA %>% mutate(total_reads_Million = total_reads/1000000) %>%
  mutate(matched_reads_pairs = matched_reads/2) %>%
  mutate(matched_reads_pairs_Million = matched_reads_pairs/1000000) %>%
  mutate(reads_non_rRNA_Million = total_reads_Million-matched_reads_pairs_Million) %>%
  mutate(uniquely_mapped_Million = uniquely_mapped/1000000)

library(ggplot2)

plot <- ggplot(POR_rRNA) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = percent_rrna, y =uniquely_mapped_percent, color=total_reads_Million)) + theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Percent rRNA reads vs. Unique Mapping Rates:\nPOR Samples")
plot
ggsave("images/POR_rRNA_v_mapping.png")

ggplot(POR_rRNA) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = percent_rrna, y =uniquely_mapped_percent, color=total_reads_Million)) + theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Percent rRNA reads vs. Unique Mapping Rates:\nPOR Samples")

ggplot(POR_rRNA) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = percent_rrna, y =total_reads_Million, color=total_reads_Million)) + theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Percent rRNA reads vs. Unique Mapping Rates:\nPOR Samples")

ggplot(POR_rRNA) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = total_reads_Million, y =uniquely_mapped_percent, color=total_reads_Million)) + theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Percent rRNA reads vs. Unique Mapping Rates:\nPOR Samples")

POR_rRNA_summary <- POR_rRNA %>% select(sample,uniquely_mapped_percent,matched_reads_pairs_Million,total_reads_Million) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(rRNA_matched_reads_Million=matched_reads_pairs_Million) %>% arrange(uniquely_mapped_percent) %>%
  mutate(across(contains("_"), ~ round(as.numeric(.x), 2)))


POR_rRNA_summary %>% pivot_longer(cols = contains("_"),
               names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() 


write_csv(POR_rRNA_summary, "../output_RNA/differential_expression/POR_Pcomp/rRNA_and_mapping_metadata.csv")
```
